const (
	AnalyticsSessionStart AnalyticsKind = "session_start"
	AnalyticsSessionEnd   AnalyticsKind = "session_end"
	AnalyticsToolStart    AnalyticsKind = "tool_call_start"
	AnalyticsToolEnd      AnalyticsKind = "tool_call_end"
	AnalyticsLLMCall      AnalyticsKind = "llm_call"
)

const (
	PhaseRunStart            Phase = "run_start"
	PhaseInputCommitted      Phase = "input_committed"
	PhaseIterationStart      Phase = "iteration_start"
	PhasePrepareModelRequest Phase = "prepare_model_request"
	PhaseModelCallStart      Phase = "model_call_start"
	PhaseBeforeModel         Phase = "before_model"
	PhaseAroundModel         Phase = "around_model"
	PhaseAfterModel          Phase = "after_model"
	PhaseModelCallEnd        Phase = "model_call_end"
	PhaseAssistantCommitted  Phase = "assistant_committed"
	PhaseToolBatchDeclared   Phase = "tool_batch_declared"
	PhaseToolBatchPlanned    Phase = "tool_batch_planned"
	PhaseToolUseDeclared     Phase = "tool_use_declared"
	PhasePrepareTool         Phase = "prepare_tool"
	PhaseBeforeTool          Phase = "before_tool"
	PhaseAroundTool          Phase = "around_tool"
	PhaseAfterTool           Phase = "after_tool"
	PhaseToolResultCommitted Phase = "tool_result_committed"
	PhaseToolBatchEnd        Phase = "tool_batch_end"
	PhaseAfterTurn           Phase = "after_turn"
	PhaseIterationEnd        Phase = "iteration_end"
	PhaseRunEnd              Phase = "run_end"
)

const (
	ProviderAPICall           ProviderErrorKind = "api_call"
	ProviderEmptyResponse     ProviderErrorKind = "empty_response"
	ProviderInvalidArgument   ProviderErrorKind = "invalid_argument"
	ProviderInvalidPrompt     ProviderErrorKind = "invalid_prompt"
	ProviderInvalidResponse   ProviderErrorKind = "invalid_response"
	ProviderJSONParse         ProviderErrorKind = "json_parse"
	ProviderCredential        ProviderErrorKind = "credential"
	ProviderSetting           ProviderErrorKind = "setting"
	ProviderNoContent         ProviderErrorKind = "no_content"
	ProviderNoSuchModel       ProviderErrorKind = "no_such_model"
	ProviderTooManyEmbeddings ProviderErrorKind = "too_many_embeddings"
	ProviderTypeValidation    ProviderErrorKind = "type_validation"
	ProviderUnsupported       ProviderErrorKind = "unsupported"
	ProviderNetwork           ProviderErrorKind = "network"
	ProviderRateLimited       ProviderErrorKind = "rate_limited"
)

const (
	TaskLocalBash         TaskKind = "local_bash"
	TaskLocalAgent        TaskKind = "local_agent"
	TaskRemoteAgent       TaskKind = "remote_agent"
	TaskInProcessTeammate TaskKind = "in_process_teammate"
	TaskLocalWorkflow     TaskKind = "local_workflow"
	TaskMonitorMCP        TaskKind = "monitor_mcp"
	TaskDream             TaskKind = "dream"
)

const (
	TaskPending   TaskStatus = "pending"
	TaskRunning   TaskStatus = "running"
	TaskSucceeded TaskStatus = "succeeded"
	TaskFailed    TaskStatus = "failed"
	TaskCancelled TaskStatus = "cancelled"
)

func (NoopAnalyticsSink) Record(AnalyticsEvent)

func (SimpleTokenEstimator) EstimateText(text string) int

func (StaticCredential) GoString() string

func (StaticCredential) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)

func (StaticCredential) String() string

func (credential StaticCredential) GetAPIKey(ctx context.Context) (string, error)

func (err *ProviderError) Error() string

func (err *ProviderError) Unwrap() error

func (estimator SimpleTokenEstimator) CountTokens(text string) int

func (estimator SimpleTokenEstimator) EstimateMessages(messages []wire.Message) (int, error)

func (event AnalyticsEvent) Validate() error

func (fn ChildCompleteFunc) Call(ctx context.Context, result SpawnResult) error

func (kind TaskKind) Prefix() (byte, error)

func (phase Phase) Valid() bool

func (registry *CommunicationRegistry) Get(kind string) (SpawnCommunication, bool)

func (registry *CommunicationRegistry) List() []SpawnCommunication

func (registry *CommunicationRegistry) Register(communication SpawnCommunication) error

func (registry *ProviderRegistry) Get(id string) (Provider, bool)

func (registry *ProviderRegistry) IDs() []string

func (registry *ProviderRegistry) LanguageModel(ctx context.Context, providerID, modelID string) (kernel.LanguageModel, error)

func (registry *ProviderRegistry) Register(provider Provider) error

func (status TaskStatus) Terminal() bool

func (task *Task) AddPaused(duration time.Duration) error

func (task *Task) AdvanceOutput(next int64) error

func (task *Task) Transition(next TaskStatus) error

func CloneAnalyticsEvent(event AnalyticsEvent) AnalyticsEvent

func NewCommunicationRegistry(capacity int) (*CommunicationRegistry, error)

func NewProviderRegistry() *ProviderRegistry

func NewStaticCredential(key string) (*StaticCredential, error)

func NewTask(kind TaskKind, title, toolUseID, outputFile string) (Task, error)

	"encoding/json"

	"time"
)

import (
	"context"
)

import (
	"encoding/json"

	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/go/sdk/llm/wire"

import (
	"errors"
	"math"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/go/sdk/llm/wire"
)

type AnalyticsEvent struct {
	Type         AnalyticsKind            `json:"type"`
	SessionID    string                   `json:"session_id"`
	RunID        string                   `json:"run_id,omitempty"`
	Time         time.Time                `json:"time"`
	SessionStart *AnalyticsSessionStarted `json:"session_start,omitempty"`
	SessionEnd   *AnalyticsSessionEnded   `json:"session_end,omitempty"`
	ToolStart    *AnalyticsToolStarted    `json:"tool_start,omitempty"`
	ToolEnd      *AnalyticsToolEnded      `json:"tool_end,omitempty"`
	LLMCall      *AnalyticsModelCall      `json:"llm_call,omitempty"`
}

type AnalyticsKind string

type AnalyticsModelCall struct {
	Provider  string      `json:"provider"`
	Model     string      `json:"model"`
	Usage     *wire.Usage `json:"usage,omitempty"`
	CostUSD   *float64    `json:"cost_usd,omitempty"`
	LatencyMS uint64      `json:"latency_ms"`
}

type AnalyticsSessionEnded struct {
	DurationMS uint64 `json:"duration_ms"`
}

type AnalyticsSessionStarted struct {
	Workspace string `json:"workspace"`
}

type AnalyticsSink interface{ Record(AnalyticsEvent) }

type AnalyticsToolEnded struct {
	Tool      string `json:"tool"`
	CallID    string `json:"call_id"`
	LatencyMS uint64 `json:"latency_ms"`
	OK        bool   `json:"ok"`
	Error     string `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type AnalyticsToolStarted struct {
	Tool   string `json:"tool"`
	CallID string `json:"call_id"`
}

type ChildCompleteFunc func(context.Context, SpawnResult) error

type ChildScopeConfig struct {
	Role, SystemPrompt string
	Timeout            time.Duration
	MaxIterations      int
}

type Command struct {
	Name        string
	Description string
}

type CommunicationRegistry struct {
}

type CredentialSource interface {
	GetAPIKey(context.Context) (string, error)
}

type NoopAnalyticsSink struct{}

type OnChildComplete interface {
	Call(context.Context, SpawnResult) error
}

type Phase string

type Provider interface {
	ID() string
	LanguageModel(context.Context, string) (kernel.LanguageModel, error)
}

type ProviderError struct {
	Kind                                                     ProviderErrorKind
	Message, URL, ResponseBody, Argument, ModelID, ModelType string
	StatusCode                                               *int
	Retryable                                                bool
	RetryAfter                                               *time.Duration
	Count, Max                                               int
	Err                                                      error
}

type ProviderErrorKind string

type ProviderRegistry struct {
}

type Scope struct {
	ID       string
	ParentID string
}

type ScopeSnapshot struct {
	ID, ParentID, Role, SessionID  string
	Depth, MaxDepth, ChildrenCount int
	Completed                      bool
}

type SimpleTokenEstimator struct{}

type SpawnCommContext struct {
	ParentScopeID, ParentSessionID, ChildScopeID, ChildSessionID, Role string
	Bus                                                                bus.Handle
}

type SpawnCommHandle struct {
	Hooks      []kernel.ContextHooks
	OnComplete OnChildComplete
}

type SpawnCommunication interface {
	Kind() string
	Description() string
	ConfigSchema() json.RawMessage
	Attach(context.Context, SpawnCommContext, json.RawMessage) (SpawnCommHandle, error)
}

type SpawnRequest struct {
	Scope     Scope
	Task      Task
	Workspace string
}

type SpawnResult struct {
	Text    string
	IsError bool
	Error   string
}

type SpawnService interface {
	Spawn(context.Context, SpawnRequest) (string, error)
	Cancel(context.Context, string) error
}

type StaticCredential struct{}

type Task struct {
	ID           string        `json:"id"`
	Kind         TaskKind      `json:"kind"`
	Title        string        `json:"title"`
	Status       TaskStatus    `json:"status"`
	ToolUseID    string        `json:"tool_use_id,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt    time.Time     `json:"created_at"`
	StartedAt    *time.Time    `json:"started_at,omitempty"`
	EndedAt      *time.Time    `json:"ended_at,omitempty"`
	TotalPaused  time.Duration `json:"total_paused_ns"`
	OutputFile   string        `json:"output_file,omitempty"`
	OutputOffset int64         `json:"output_offset"`
	Notified     bool          `json:"notified"`
}

type TaskKind string

type TaskStatus string

type TokenEstimator interface {
	EstimateText(string) int
	EstimateMessages([]wire.Message) (int, error)
}
